text:
maya: quick sync — I pushed updates to the Node + Python quickstarts: clarified `npm install` vs `yarn`, added a streaming response example and a tiny Docker snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-devex/quickstarts/pull/312

sam: saw the PR, looks good. CI is failing on the macOS runners though — `test_cli_init` keeps timing out. Re-ran once, still flaky :/

lucy: re: streaming example — can you add a short note about handling chunked responses (e.g., check for `response.body.getReader()` / `response.readable`) and a warning about long-lived connections? small nit: use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` consistently in examples.

chris: quickapp sample discovered a runtime env bug: sample uses `REDWOOD_API` in README but code expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I'll open a tiny PR to align them.

infra-bot: deploybot: workflow rerun started for quickstarts CI (PR #312) — triggered by @sam

maya: thanks. blocker for publish: internal npm registry token expired so the sample package can't be published from CI. @eng-infra can you restore access or provide a short-term token?

sam: pinged @eng-infra in #eng-infra — they said they're on it and expect a fix within ~1h.

lucy: i'll pick up doc fixes after CI green — will add the streaming note and update the changelog entry. If anyone has 2-line micro-examples to show function calling vs streaming, paste them here and I'll fold them in. :+1:

chris: opened PR for env var fix: https://github.com/redwood-devex/quickstarts/pull/315 — assigned to maya for review.

maya: ack, I'll review first thing tomorrow AM. No other blockers from my side. Thanks all! (reaction :shipit:)
